messages:
sre-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER — toolcall executor error spike detected in us-west-2. Elevated 5xx and queueing from the external action pool. Routing to eng-oncall.

maya: ack, oncall here. pulling traces and timeline.

kevin: logs -> https://internal.prod/logs/trace/0a1b2c3d — seeing large retry fanout to 3rd-party actions, KV cache pressure looks correlated.

maya: initial hypothesis: sudden burst of external tool retries + long tail host CPU causing executor queue growth. We should avoid full rollback of structured-output features. Recommend targeted holdout for tool invocations on lower-tier plans + force text-only structured output for affected routes to reduce serialization overhead.

olivia: +1. Proposed immediate mitigations: 1) apply tenant-scoped holdout to prevent new external tool invocations for free/trial plans, 2) set structured_output_mode=text_only for streaming endpoints in us-west, 3) apply stricter per-tenant rate caps for the pool, 4) notify support and customers.

maya: executing plan now. Rolling in stages (10% -> 50% -> 100%) to avoid config storms. Steps: 
```
# apply holdout via admin API
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.internal/admin/quarantine" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ADMIN_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{"scope":"plans:free,trial","action":"hold_toolcalls","reason":"surge_2024-03-15"}'
```

jamal: pushing rate-limit change now:
```
/ops apply-rate-limits --scope plans:free,trial --rps 1 --burst 5 --reason "toolcall_surge_us-west"
```

kevin: also mapping a header to make SDKs fall back gracefully: `X-Disable-Toolcalls: true` for the impacted tenant bundle so clients will switch to text-only parsing rather than erroring.

maya: rolling to 10% -> verifying metrics. Watching error budget and 95p latency.

(2m) maya: update — queue length trending down, 5xx from executor pool down from 18% -> 6%. Latency 95p improved ~40ms. No high-severity customer incidents reported yet.

olivia: writing short customer note for support: "We're temporarily limiting tool-based features for free and trial accounts in the affected region to stabilize execution capacity. Paid customers are not affected. We're working to restore full behavior and will follow up." Put that in #support-ops.

jamal: created ticket INC-4321 and initial postmortem stub: https://confluence.internal/INC-4321. Please add any timeline or config diffs.

kevin: handing off monitoring and follow-up to SRE rotation for the 06:30 UTC check-in. Oncall takeover: olivia.

olivia: ack takeover. Will keep the holdout in place until we see stable <5% executor 5xx for 30m and confirm no major customer impacts. Reminder: plan a gradual rollback (50%->100% removed) rather than a single flip.

sre-bot: :white_check_mark: Mitigation applied: tenant holdout + structured_output_mode=text_only + rate caps. Continue monitoring for 1h. Escalate if 5xx >= 10% or if any paid-customer impact is observed.

maya: quick note — we'll include the exact config diffs in the incident doc and capture RPC traces for the affected window.

kevin: leaving a short runbook action: after stable window, run `admin/quarantine --revert --ticket INC-4321` and coordinate with SDK leads for any unexpected client fallbacks.

olivia: posted comm to #support-ops and pinged top 5 customers in the region as a precaution.

jamal: thanks team — good triage.

sre-bot: :memo: Follow-up: postmortem draft and rollback checklist due EOD.
